name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-sega-cd-orb-tower-exterior
title: Popful Mail (SEGA CD) - Orb Tower (Exterior)
description:
The background seen in the exterior parts of Orb Tower, from the SEGA CD version of Popful Mail. This background is best if used with a fast non-stop parallaxing scrolling, like in the original game. A good fit for sky levels, in general. Lightning effects not included due to how painful is to debug SEGA CD games.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
